title: Exercise figures
description: Small stick-figure drawings for exercises, on a 48 × 48 grid with the floor at y = 45 (x grows to the right, y grows downward). Exercises pick one with their `figure` field; several exercises can share a figure. The app draws the gear the exercise uses (barbell, dumbbell, kettlebell, med ball, cable or band) at the `hold` points.

path.description: SVG path data using only M, L, H, V, C, A and Z commands.

id.description: Figure id that exercises refer to.

lines.description: Body and limbs, each a polyline of x,y points separated by spaces.

hold.description: Where the hands hold the weight. Two points for a weight in each hand.

anchor.description: Where a cable or band is attached. Defaults to the top right corner.

gear.description: How to draw the gear: bar-back (plate seen from the side), bar-over (bar across both hands), band-between (band stretched between the hands).

scene.description: Bench, box, rack or other props, drawn in a lighter line.

dashed.description: Dashed lines, for example the arc of a jump.
